'''Herman Eldon Brockman''' (February 4, 1934 – April 8, 2025) was an American [[geneticist]].<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.newspapers.com/newspage/72938916/|title=His mutation study may help save lives|work=[[The Pantagraph]]|location=[[Bloomington, Illinois]]|date=January 5, 1975|access-date=July 5, 2025|page=17|via=[[Newspapers.com]]}} {{Closed access}}</ref>

== Life and career ==
Brockman was born in [[Danforth, Illinois]], the son of Fred Brockman and Henrietta Zeedyk. He attended [[Blackburn College (Illinois)|Blackburn College]], graduating in 1956. After graduating, he attended [[Northwestern University]], earning his [[Master of Science|MS degree]] in 1957. He also attended [[Florida State University]], earning his [[Doctor of Philosophy|PhD degree]] in 1960, which after earning his degrees, he worked as a [[Postdoctoral researcher|postdoctoral fellow]] in the [[biology]] division at [[Oak Ridge National Laboratory]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.legacy.com/us/obituaries/pantagraph/name/herman-brockman-obituary?id=58475400|title=Herman Brockman Obituary (1934-2025)|work=[[The Pantagraph]]|date=May 25, 2025|access-date=July 5, 2025|via=[[Legacy.com]]}}</ref>

Brockman served as a professor in the department of [[biological science]] at [[Illinois State University]] from 1963 to 1998.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://news.illinoisstate.edu/2025/06/remembering-the-magic-of-distinguished-professor-emeritus-of-genetics-herman-e-brockman/|title=Remembering the magic of Distinguished Professor Emeritus of Genetics Herman E. Brockman|first=David M.|last=DeMarini|work=[[Illinois State University|Illinois State University News]]|date=June 3, 2025|access-date=July 5, 2025}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.newspapers.com/newspage/75496268/|title=Brockman bids goodbye: Students honor retiring professor with symposium|work=[[The Pantagraph]]|location=[[Bloomington, Illinois]]|date=April 18, 1998|access-date=July 5, 2025|page=4|via=[[Newspapers.com]]}} {{Closed access}}</ref> During his years as a professor, in 1982, he was named a [[distinguished professor]].<ref name="a">{{Cite web|url=https://www.online-tribute.com/herman-brockman|title=Herman E. Brockman|work=Online Tribute|access-date=July 5, 2025}}</ref>

== Death ==
Brockman died on April 8, 2025, in [[Congerville, Illinois]], at the age of 91.<ref name="a" />
